capabilities_done: parse(): dependency-free byte scanner; every node keeps its exact source byte span; children tile the parent content so concatenated spans equal the source; unedited round trip is byte-exact (source retained, apply of an empty patch returns identical bytes and revision)

Subset: elements with explicit end tags, attributes (double/single/unquoted/valueless, name_span/value_span/quote kept), text, comments (incl. abrupt <!--> and <!--->), doctype, void elements, raw-text script/style/iframe/noembed/noframes/xmp and RCDATA textarea/title kept as one opaque Raw child, svg/math with self-closing; pre is parsed normally and flagged protected
Opaque + loss entry (never patched): CDATA, processing instructions, bogus markup; loss report also records SelfClosingIgnored, DuplicateAttribute (first wins), ForeignContent; capped at 4096 entries

Typed refusals with exact spans, never guessed: misnested/stray/void end tags, unclosed element, optional end tags (Unsupported ImpliedEndTag), unterminated tag/comment/value/raw text, plaintext, limits (bytes, nodes, depth, attributes, edits), cancellation checked every 1024 tokens

DOM view: WebDoc::view (pre-order rows with depth, decoded attrs/text), key_of/resolve stable path keys (/0:html/1:body), find_by_tag, find_by_html_id, text_content, descendants (explicit stack, safe at any depth)

Patch ops as TextEdit span replacements bound to base revision + sha256: set_attribute (keeps quote style, appends after last attribute, valueless -> ="v"), remove_attribute (with its leading whitespace), set_text (text node, text-only element, raw/RCDATA bodies with unsafe-close refusal), remove_node, insert_element, insert_fragment (fragment must parse inside the subset); apply (StaleRevision, Conflict, OverlappingEdits, InvalidSpan, size limit, revision overflow), SourcePatch::compose, WebDoc::apply_patch (apply + reparse)
Entities: common named set + numeric (invalid -> U+FFFD), unresolved well-formed references reported verbatim, escape_text/escape_attr

responsive: parse_media_query (min-width/max-width px, and, comma list, all/screen/only), Breakpoint::matches, scan_media_blocks + document_media_blocks over style bodies (comments/strings skipped, nesting depth, per-query typed errors in document offsets); unsupported media type/feature/unit/syntax typed
WebError::code() + outcome() mapping to observe::Outcome; DESCRIPTOR JSON (validated parseable); examples/web-consumer.rs run against a synthetic CRLF file (tree, set-attr byte-exact output, media)

slice 2 refresh: refresh(old, new_src, old.revision+1) re-parses at exactly R+1 (any other revision is StaleRevision) and returns a KeyMap (old<->new ids, map_key, added/removed subtree roots + exact node counts); identity = prefix/suffix, then HTML-id elements in any order, then id-less siblings by tag in order; equals parse(apply(patch)) (asserted on view rows and sha)

slice 2 assets: collect_assets over img/source/video/audio/iframe/embed/track/input src, link/a/area/use href, object data, video poster, style attribute url(), style body url() and @import string; only relative references reach the AssetPort; external schemes, //, file:, javascript:/vbscript: (also through entity/newline tricks) are typed Denied without a port call; data: = Inline, #x = SameDocument; Granted/Unavailable/Denied from the port; spans point at the reference bytes; cancellation before the port is consulted

slice 2 preview: preview_tree(doc, width) = per-element role, accessible name (aria-labelledby, aria-label, alt, label for/wrapping, value, content, title), heading level, focusable, tabindex, tab_order (positive ascending then natural; negative/disabled skipped), display resolved from inline style tag rules gated by the @media chain at the width (importance, origin, specificity, order), hidden attribute / input hidden / aria-hidden, unnamed list; carries source_revision and viewport width; unsupported rules listed (at-rules, combinators/attribute/pseudo selectors, nested blocks, unsupported media queries)

slice 2 observe: report()/outcome_of() deliver Success | Canceled | Failure(Validation|Unsupported) with correlation id and revision only (no source text); a cancelled token reports Canceled; wrong revision refused by observe

R5-B 1: CSS URL references come from a CSS Syntax 3 tokenizer (cssurl.rs): escapes decoded before matching (u\72l( , \75rl( , ht\74p: , hex + optional whitespace, escaped newline in strings), url/function/string/bad-url tokens, comments/strings/xurl(/1url(/url (/url/**/( are not url tokens; bad-url reported but never offered to the port

R5-B 1: HTML character references are decoded before classification (charref.rs): numeric with or without semicolon and any digit count, URL/CSS punctuation names (colon sol bsol Tab NewLine lpar rpar ...); other well-formed named references deny the value (Denied UndecodableReference)

R5-B 2: any <base href> (any value, any position, also valueless) makes every relative reference Denied(BaseHref); the base itself is reported; URL attribute set extended from the WHATWG attribute index (srcset, imagesrcset, poster, object data/codebase/classid/archive, form action, formaction, cite, ping, obsolete background/longdesc/lowsrc/manifest, meta refresh url, href and xlink:href on every element, svg url() presentation attributes, svg style text and CDATA, iframe srcdoc reported Denied(InlineDocument)); DESCRIPTOR scanned/not_scanned updated
R5-B PLAUSIBLE: relative paths with a backslash or percent-encoded dot/slash/backslash are Denied(AmbiguousPath) before the port

R6-B 1: exact WHATWG character references (charref.rs + generated entity_table.rs, 2231 entries incl. 106 legacy names without ';', longest match, attribute-value rule for '=' and alphanumerics, numeric states with the windows-1252 C1 table); one decoder with Text/Attribute context for asset scanning, attr_value, text_content, view and decode_entities; Denied(UndecodableReference) removed (unknown names are literal for a browser too)

R6-B 2: tree-construction context: Node.namespace (Html/Svg/MathMl), dispatcher with HTML integration points (svg foreignObject/desc/title, annotation-xml encoding text/html|application/xhtml+xml) and MathML text integration points (mi mo mn ms mtext, not mglyph/malignmark), foreign start tags inherit the parent namespace, void only in HTML; style under integration points is RAWTEXT

R6-B sweep (same class): comment end at --!>, script data escaped/double-escaped states, CDATA section only under a foreign current node (else bogus comment to the first '>'), typed refusals foreign_breakout, scripting_dependent (noscript RAWTEXT reading ends earlier), select_content, frameset_document; foreign style sheet = child text content (text + CDATA concatenated)
R6-B PLAUSIBLE: SVG set/animate to/from/by/values scanned when attributeName is href, xlink:href, src or a url() presentation attribute

CDATA/PI/bogus markup are opaque Unsupported nodes with a loss entry (document still round-trips and other nodes stay patchable) instead of failing the whole parse; ops targeting them are refused (Opaque)
Optional end tags (p, li, td, ...) are Unsupported ImpliedEndTag, per brief; a trailing unclosed one reports at its open tag
Self-closing slash on a non-void HTML element follows HTML (ignored, element stays open) and is recorded as SelfClosingIgnored; inside svg/math it closes the element

Missing attribute inserts after the last attribute (not directly after the tag name) so existing attribute order and spacing stay untouched; unquoted values that need quoting become double-quoted (the only quote-style change)
NodeKey = /<index>:<lower-case tag or #kind> path, computed on demand from parent links (no per-node key storage, bounded memory)
Entity decoding requires the terminating semicolon; legacy semicolon-less forms stay verbatim (SUPERSEDED in R6 by exact WHATWG decoding: see remediation_R6)
